name: Xcode Derived Data
description: Build products and indexes of your projects; Xcode rebuilds them, so the next build of each project takes longer.

name: Xcode Previews
description: Builds and simulators made for SwiftUI previews; Xcode recreates them the next time a preview is shown.

name: Device Support Files
description: Debug symbols Xcode copied from connected iPhones, Watches and other devices; Xcode copies them again the next time a device with that system version is connected.

name: Xcode Archives
description: Builds you archived for distribution, with their debug symbols; without them you can no longer symbolicate crash reports of those releases or upload them again.

name: Simulator Caches
description: Caches of the iOS Simulator (your simulated devices and their apps are kept); they are rebuilt when a simulator next starts.

name: Swift Package Manager Cache
description: Downloaded package repositories and binary artifacts; Swift Package Manager downloads them again when a project needs them.

name: CocoaPods Cache
description: Downloaded pods and specs; CocoaPods downloads them again on the next pod install.

name: Carthage Cache
description: Downloaded dependencies and binaries; Carthage downloads them again when needed.

name: Homebrew Downloads
description: Downloaded bottles, casks and package lists (what brew cleanup removes); installed packages keep working and Homebrew downloads files again when needed.

name: npm Cache
description: Downloaded packages and npx tools; npm downloads them again when needed.

name: Yarn Cache
description: Downloaded packages; Yarn downloads them again on the next install.

name: pnpm Store
description: Packages shared by all your projects through hard links; space is only freed for packages no project uses any more, and pnpm downloads the others again on the next install.

name: Bun Cache
description: Downloaded packages and compiled code; Bun downloads and compiles them again when needed.

name: Deno Cache
description: Downloaded modules and compiled code; Deno downloads and compiles them again when needed.

name: pip Cache
description: Downloaded and built Python packages; pip downloads them again when needed.

name: uv Cache
description: Downloaded and built Python packages (your virtual environments and installed Pythons are kept); uv downloads them again when needed.

name: Gradle Caches
description: Downloaded dependencies, Gradle versions and build outputs; Gradle downloads and rebuilds them, so the next build is slower and needs a network connection.

name: Maven Repository
description: Downloaded libraries plus anything you installed locally with mvn install; Maven downloads published libraries again, but locally installed ones are lost.

name: Cargo Cache
description: Downloaded crates and Git dependencies; Cargo downloads them again on the next build.

name: Go Build Cache
description: Compiled Go packages; Go compiles them again, so the next build takes longer.

name: JetBrains and Android Studio Caches
description: Indexes and caches of JetBrains IDEs and Android Studio, including old versions; the IDE rebuilds its indexes when it next opens a project, which takes a while.

name: Android SDK Cache
description: Package lists downloaded by the Android SDK manager; it downloads them again when needed.

name: Test Browsers
description: Browsers downloaded by Playwright and Puppeteer for automated tests; tests fail until you install them again (npx playwright install, or reinstall Puppeteer).

name: Hugging Face Models
description: Downloaded AI models and datasets; they are downloaded again, often several gigabytes, the next time a program uses them.

name: Claude Code MCP Logs
description: Logs Claude Code keeps of its MCP servers for each project; they are only needed to troubleshoot those servers.

name: Google Chrome Cache
description: Web pages, scripts and graphics Chrome stored to load sites faster (history, passwords and logins are kept); sites load a bit slower until it fills again.

name: Microsoft Edge Cache
description: Web pages, scripts and graphics Edge stored to load sites faster (history, passwords and logins are kept); sites load a bit slower until it fills again.

name: Brave Cache
description: Web pages, scripts and graphics Brave stored to load sites faster (history, passwords and logins are kept); sites load a bit slower until it fills again.

name: Arc Cache
description: Web pages, scripts and graphics Arc stored to load sites faster (history, passwords and logins are kept); sites load a bit slower until it fills again.

name: Firefox Cache
description: Web pages, scripts and graphics Firefox stored to load sites faster (history, passwords and logins are kept); sites load a bit slower until it fills again.

name: App Web Caches
description: Web and graphics caches of apps built on Electron or Chromium, such as Slack, Discord, VS Code or Claude (your data and logins are kept); each app rebuilds them when it next starts. Quit these apps first.

name: Crash and Diagnostic Reports
description: Reports macOS wrote when apps crashed or hung; they are only useful to send to a developer.

name: User Logs
description: Log files apps write while they run; they are only needed to troubleshoot problems, and apps start new ones.

name: Other App Caches
description: Everything else apps keep in your Caches folder; apps rebuild it, but are slower at first and some lose downloaded content such as offline music or maps. Quit apps first.
